CommonJS compatibility build of upstream decode-uri-component 0.5.0 from npm. Includes the upstream fix for GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr. Changes: replace the ESM default export with module.exports and retain the 0.2.x plus-to-space behavior required by existing callers. Upstream MIT license retained. Remove the override when Expo Router adopts a compatible patched query-string dependency.
